descriptionHtml:
In essence it's the previous Player Faction Flag Pack but in a broken down build-your-own-pack style.

There's over unique 2,000 flags/crests to pick from as they are all real flags from every nook and cranny of Japan.

Basic instructions (Or follow the README):
  • Download the zip file and install it
  • Download the flags/crests of your choice into mod graphics
  • Edit player.faction in mod data

Link to mod and assets here: Google Drive.
  • Not all flags are added as there's a couple hundred that need retouching/redrawing.
  • If you notice some flags/crests are dodgy, lemme know and I'll fix em (eventually).
  • Some flags with texts and location names have been edited to make them more generic.
  • Feel free to remove the flags/crests already included cause they're just placeholders.

Credits:
Ur Noobie - Powershell wizard who scraped most of the flags off Wikipedia
Haze - Original Player Faction Flag Pack

Changelog:
August 2020 - Re-uploaded images (including the placeholder ones in the mod) in 24-bit instead of 8-bit
August 2020 - Initial Release
June 2021 - Updated modinfo.json
aiDescription: Adds over 2,000 real-world Japanese flags and crests, allowing players to build their own custom faction flag pack. The flags are sourced from various regions across Japan and are provided in high-quality 24-bit format. Some flags with text or location names have been modified to be more generic, and placeholders can be replaced with custom choices.
